title: I Lay Me Down
lyrics: Verse 1:
[D]I lay me down [G]I lay me down
[D]I lay me down [G]I lay me down
A [C]living [G]sacrifice to [D]you, a [C]living [G]sacrifice to [D]you
Verse 2:
[D]I lay it down, [G]I lay it down
[D]I lay it down, [G]I lay it down
A [C]pleasing [G]sacrifice to [D]you, a [C]pleasing [G]sacrifice to [D]you
Verse 3:
[E]I lift you up, [A]I lift you up
[E]I lift you up, [A]I lift you up
And [D]freedom will [A]be the song of my [E]heart
And [D]freedom will [A]be the song of my [E]heart
Verse 4:
[E]I lay me down, [A]I lay me down
[E]I lay me down, [A]I lay me down
And [D]freedom is [A]now the song of my [E]heart (feel free to get crazy here)
And [D]freedom is [A]now the song of my [E]heart (repeat as much as you want)
Verse 5:
(Singing softly and barely strumming the guitar)
[E]At the foot of the cross I lay my life down
Verse 6:
At the foot of the cross I lay down my crown
There is [A]freedom there Lord I lay my life [E]down
Verse 7:
[E]Teach me Lord to deny myself
Verse 8:
To take up your cross to deny myself
To [A]walk with you to follow you to honor you
For the rest of my [E]days
Verse 9:
And [D]I...and [A]I lay my life [E]down
D A (whisper) (pluck the low-E string only toend)
And I...and I lay my life down
